Bid Summary: This RFP is for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors.

Major Products/Services Requested: Student and Staff Computing Devices.

Contract Information: The contract term is three (3) years with two (2) successive one (1) year extensions, not to exceed five (5) years total. Record retention requirements for contracts involving federal funds are for a period of three years after grantees or subgrantees submit final expenditure reports or quarterly/annual financial reports.
